# Ceylonry POS

> Ceylonry POS by CeylonryLabs.io is point-of-sale software for Sri Lankan retail shops, restaurants, cafés, salons and other service businesses. It runs in the browser and works on a counter terminal, tablet or phone. Plans start at LKR 5,500 per month.
